death.attack.skyabyss.heat_burst.player: %1$s was burned by the heat of %2$s
death.attack.skyabyss.engulfed.player: %1$s was pushed into the embers by %2$s
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.asleep: The earth smells hot. Somewhere, a mountain is breathing in its sleep...
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.mouth_hin: While it breathes in, walk into the mouth
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.spat_out: The titan's breath spat you out. Not yet.
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.stone.giv: A warm pebble sits in your pocket, fired clay of the ash folk. Hold it, and a far heat moves into your hand.
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.stone.not: Grip it while standing on solid land.
The stone does not answer. Try again around sunset.
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.stone.no_: There is no flat ground here for a mountain to lie down on.
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.stone.ask: The stone grows hot. Tonight, the mountain sleeps beside you.
The warm stone leans toward %s. It will sleep there tonight.
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.stone.too: Held, the warmer hand points toward the Ember Titan
Grip it on land around sunset to ask it to sleep nearby
commands.skyabyss.ember.missing: The ember titan is not loaded
commands.skyabyss.ember.no_spot: No sleeping place nearby (flat land 16 blocks in front of the mouth)
commands.skyabyss.ember.status: Ember titan: %s (breath %s) %s %s %s, %s s until it sleeps
commands.skyabyss.ember.status_absent: The ember titan is not loaded (appeared: %s). %s s until it sleeps

message.skyabyss.ember.back.arrived: It is hot. The ash underfoot is warm, like breath.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.leaving: Down the ash steps, the night air was cold.
